motion.reducedMotionRule: replace nonessential spatial/continuous motion; preserve state change through text, shape, and discrete position

user-authored.description: Solid unbroken outline with no fill pattern, read at a glance even on a thin timeline-clip border.

live-generated.description: Dotted outline in place of the solid line, signalling the clip is a live projection rather than committed material.

snapshot.description: Diagonal hatch fill over a solid outline, the frozen-snapshot mark the mockup campaign's material legend already converged on.

edited-derivative.description: A notched corner on an otherwise dashed outline, the distinct mark that separates a hand-edited derivative from its source.

not-applicable.description: Plain rectangle with no border pattern or fill, meaning this axis does not apply to the item.

current.description: Solid unbroken outline, the same baseline mark used elsewhere, signalling the source is current.

changed.description: Dashed outline replacing the solid line, signalling the upstream source has changed since it was last checked.

missing.description: Sparse stippled fill inside a solid outline, signalling the source file could not be found.

detached.description: Diamond badge on a dashed outline, signalling the link to the source was deliberately detached.

unresolved.description: A question-mark glyph on a broken dash-dot outline; this ambiguous state needs the extra room of an inspector row and cannot be read reliably at timeline-clip scale.

idle.description: Solid unbroken outline with no fill, the same baseline mark used elsewhere, meaning nothing is being computed.

preview.description: Dotted outline signalling a tentative, not-yet-committed computation preview.

evaluating.description: Chevron-shaped badge on a dashed outline, signalling active computation in progress.

current.description: Fully solid fill inside a solid outline, signalling the result is up to date.

cache-only.description: Diagonal hatch fill, the same mark used for a frozen snapshot on the material axis, signalling the value is served from cache rather than freshly computed.

stale.description: Denser crosshatch fill than the cache-only mark, plus a dashed outline, signalling the cached result has drifted from its inputs.

error.description: A single exclamation glyph on a notched badge, signalling computation failed.

cancelled.description: Diamond badge on a broken dash-dot outline, signalling the computation was deliberately cancelled rather than failing.

disabled.description: Plain rectangle with no border or fill, signalling audio is disabled.

arming.description: Dotted outline signalling audio is arming to start.

playing.description: Solid fill inside a solid outline, signalling audio is actively playing.

paused.description: Dashed outline signalling audio is paused mid-stream.

interrupted.description: Notched badge on a dashed outline, signalling playback was interrupted before it finished.

reconfiguring.description: Stippled fill over a dotted outline, signalling the audio engine is reconfiguring.

error.description: A single exclamation glyph, signalling a recoverable audio error.

panic.description: A doubled exclamation glyph on a double-lined notched badge, escalating past the single-error mark to signal an unrecoverable panic stop.

established.description: Fully solid fill, the top of the confidence ramp, signalling a fully established claim.

strong-inference.description: Diagonal hatch fill, the same mark used for a frozen snapshot elsewhere, one step down the confidence ramp for a strongly inferred but not directly established claim.

engineering-default.description: Hatch fill on the opposite diagonal from strong-inference, signalling a pragmatic engineering default rather than a verified claim.

experimental.description: Sparse stippled fill plus a dashed outline, signalling an experimental, unverified claim.

research-gated.description: A lock glyph on a notched badge, the bottom of the confidence ramp, signalling the claim is gated behind pending research and not yet actionable.

source.description: The letter S on a plain rectangle, marking the first stage of the pipeline; this whole axis needs inspector-row room and cannot be told apart at timeline-clip scale.

sample.description: A single dot on a circular badge, marking the discrete-sampling stage.

normalize.description: The letter N on a rounded rectangle, marking the normalization stage.

smooth.description: A tilde mark on a pill-shaped badge, marking the smoothing stage.

transform.description: The letter T on a diamond badge, marking the transform stage.

quantize-threshold.description: The letter Q on a notched badge with a dashed outline, marking the quantize/threshold stage.

constrain.description: The letter C on a chevron badge, marking the constraint stage.

target.description: A bullseye mark on a double-outlined circular badge, marking the final target stage of the pipeline.

selected.description: Solid unbroken outline, the same baseline mark used elsewhere, marking a selected item.

primary.description: Double-lined outline, one step up from the plain selected mark, marking the primary item within a multi-selection.

focused.description: Dashed rounded-corner outline marking keyboard focus.

hovered.description: Dotted pill-shaped outline marking a pointer hover target.

related.description: Diagonal hatch fill, the same mark used for a frozen snapshot elsewhere, marking an item related through provenance to the current selection.

orphaned.description: Sparse stippled fill on a broken dash-dot outline, marking an item whose provenance link has been lost.
